chunks: 4919 - Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:

Indeed, one of you comes to his wife, then she departs from beneath him; if she were to encounter a black man, she would cling to him. So when one of you comes to his wife, let there be mutual foreplay between them, for that is more pleasant for the matter.

key_terms.أَطْيَبُ: more pleasant, more agreeable, and better in quality
key_terms.أَهْلَهُ: his wife or spouse in the context of marital intimacy
key_terms.زِنْجِيًّا: a black man, mentioned in the wording of the report as a rhetorical comparison
key_terms.لِلْأَمْرِ: for the matter, meaning for the affair of intimacy
key_terms.مُدَاعَبَةٌ: mutual foreplay, playful affectionate interaction between spouses

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about foreplay and tenderness between spouses?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches marital etiquette and emphasizes tenderness and mutual affection between spouses during intimacy. It indicates that affectionate preparation is more wholesome and pleasing in conjugal relations.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4919 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Indeed, one of you may approach his wife, and she departs from beneath him; if she were to encounter a black man, she would cling to him. Therefore, when one of you approaches his wife, there should be mutual foreplay between them, for it is more pleasant and better for intimacy."
